usedFor: A shopper who stalls at Shopify checkout lands in Autopilot as a new client.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Client” in Autopilot
bestTemplate.why: The abandoned checkout has the email or phone a new client record needs.

watchOut: “Update Client” requires a client ID, so run “Create Client” first and keep that ID.
